user_messages: 你可以用GPU1，这样会不会快一点

question: Can local balanced positive/negative absolute CE improve frozen near thin skeleton d1 recall versus N0 with protected segmentation quality? No NR, lesion-specificity or anatomical connectivity claim.

method.empty: graph-connected zero; no valid negative -> omit whole group; keep empty crops in B denominator

training.train_and_internal_monitor: Train110 only; native one worker per pool, seed and seed+1; no Dev during training
training.attempt_budget: success+verified safe AMP skips=25000; no catch-up; failures/unknown/replays never cleared

pairing.eligibility: ELIGIBLE_FOR_CONDITIONAL_ONLINE_PAIRING; full NL alignment not yet demonstrated
initial_compare: RNG at same original initialization point
pairing.monitor_limit: Original monitors contain IDs only, no input/GT byte hashes. Do not claim retrospective monitor byte equivalence; preserve source/seed/schedule and compare IDs. No optimizer update in monitoring.
pairing.mismatch: stop before forward/update; no automatic rebaseline or downgrade of comparison
pairing.explanation: Same input attempt budget and optimizer rule, not forced same number of successful updates. Report differing skip counts as training response.
pairing.at_end: all25000 rows and5000 monitor IDs matched before declaring strict training input pairing

runtime.GPU_admission: no compute processes, memory used<512MiB, utilization<10%; refuse busy device, do not kill or switch

estimate_basis.warning: Short-run file timestamps include startup/checkpoint overhead; not isolated steady-state benchmark. No new timing experiment.

runtime.wall_cap_action: stop safely, preserve partial result; no budget extension/restart automatically
runtime.unattended: detached server controller, one-shot bound release, child parent-death guard; SSH disconnect harmless
runtime.failed_seed: stop remaining controller phases; do not run seed2028 after unresolved technical failure or infer partial checkpoint

delegation.GPU1: seed2028 fresh exactly once; then terminal-only inference bothseeds serial
delegation.old_queue_barrier: actual seed2028 train.log opened exclusive before spawn; original native open(x) rejects duplicate before Popen
delegation.expected_original_queue_exit: FileExistsError for canonical seed2028/train.log only after successful2027, classified expected retirement; never suppress any scientific failure

gradients.unweighted_component_grads: autograd.grad with retain_graph; must not accumulate into parameter.grad or alter RNG
gradients.norm: all trainable parameters, preclip L2; absent grad zero; FP64 aggregate
gradients.zero_denominator: both exactly0 -> ratio0 and cosineNA; base0 with aux>0 -> stop
gradients.cosine: dot(g_base,g_aux)/(norms), zero norm NA; record but no newly invented cosine stop
gradients.diagnostic_nonfinite: stop before optimizer; no auto rescale/retry or lambda change
gradients.training_gradient_nonfinite: only original proven AMP safe-skip path allowed, model/optimizer unchanged and scale reduced; otherwise fatal
gradients.post_update_nonfinite: fatal, preserve charged update; never rollback silently
gradients.no_double_backward_update: component diagnostics do not call optimizer; exactly one total-loss backward and at most one optimizer step per attempt

checkpoints.latest: atomic full snapshot after attempts30,200 and every250; also after each official epoch-end
checkpoints.recovery: native asynchronous queue exact recovery not verified; no automatic resume/replay/restart; save interrupted snapshot and failure ledger, return for review

inference.only_after: both seeds finished100epochs and full input pairing verified
inference.N0: reuse existing bound probabilities; do not infer again
inference.failure: retain completed tiles/images and counters, no automatic inference rerun

evaluation.primary_signal: Eachseed mean NL-N0 >0 AND lower bound of pooled-within-image-across-seeds paired95CI >0
evaluation.Dice_guard: Eachseed image-mean NL-N0 >=0 as conservative point-estimate screen; report CI separately, no proof of no degradation from nonsignificance
evaluation.local_FP_primary: Image macro FP/(frozen Rnear & Omega area),18 original nonempty images; same fixed support
evaluation.local_FP_guard: Eachseed mean delta<=0; pooled paired CI upper<=0 needed for interval-level no-increase evidence; crossing0 uncertain
local_FP_supplements: per-image and pooled totals, separate from macro
auxiliary: leave-one-image-out sensitivity, not deletion or replacement primary
limitations: Two seeds do not create independent patients
Original thin-point definition not anatomical whole-branch guarantee
No NR so no lesion specificity
GT-relative automatic results not expert medical verification
result_categories: Local gain and point/interval guard evidence separately stated
evaluation.per_seed_guard_unit: Each seed paired image-macro NL-N0 on the frozen valid set for that metric; never pool pixels or treat seeds as patients
evaluation.other_guard_CI: Report per-seed and within-image-seed-averaged paired95CI; upper<=0 for FP/FOV, lower>=0 for Precision/farRecall and Dice are interval-level nonadverse evidence, distinct from point screens; no formal noninferiority claim
evaluation.full_success_wording: Primary signal plus all point guards -> local gain signal with point protection on reused Dev. Claim interval-supported protection only for guards whose adverse-direction CI bound also passes; crossing zero remains unknown, never independent validation.

output_contract.creation: Approved GPU1 resource delegation, same two canonical scientific runs
files: SCIENCE_RELEASE.json after approval and CPU admission
output_contract.authority: Existing STATUS and project research decisions only

implementation_acceptance_before_release: Reuse existing native constructor/loop and proven sparse auxiliary implementation; adapt metadata sidecar without changing native arrays/RNG
Do not import CPU replay.py into GPU worker: it sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; extract audited pure mapping functions with source binding
Geometry/GT candidate sidecar travels with each actual batch; select negatives in main process using consumed attempt, not producer prefetch ordinal
CPU integration compare first32 batches each seed to existing historical hashes and all-target traces, including original discard; no model forward/GPU

CPU mocked one-shot authorization, stage/digest mismatch, duplicate launch, counters persisted before operation, no optimizer before all checks, monitor no-update, fail/unknown/skip totals and no automatic resume
Reuse completed GPU engineering evidence; do not invent another GPU acceptance budget or reuse fixtures cyclically for science
Freeze implementation hashes, evaluation reference and this card; user scientific approval and Sol source/CPU review required before release
completion: Complete fair evidence including negative or technically failed runs is a complete engineering delivery. Scientific effectiveness is judged separately. No new experiment automatically.
